title: Encoded arithmetic row
statement: For a Boolean list $w$, define its row to be the result of applying the Boolean-list pairing, arithmetic, and entrywise operations in the displayed construction to the indicated nested first and second components of $w$.
caveat: The meanings of the pairing, arithmetic, and entrywise operations used in the construction are not supplied, so a more explicit mathematical description cannot be verified.
